messages:
alex: Heads-up — proposing a tweak to routing header semantics for region/tier overrides. Want quick UX + quota implications review before we merge the SDK change.

maya: high level — what's changing? is this a breaking change for older SDKs?

alex: Not breaking. New precedence: explicit SDK param > X-Redwood-Tier header > account tier. Legacy clients without header keep current behavior.

alex: Proposed headers:

```
X-Redwood-Region: eu-central-1
X-Redwood-Tier: enterprise
X-Redwood-Routing-Debug: prefer-variant=v2;trace=on
```

sam: billing concern — if we route enterprise to cheaper variants it could change unit costs. We must keep invoicing tied to account id, not execution location.

jordan: quotas: agree. Execution location ok to change, but capacity accounting should remain per-account/commit. Suggest adding routing_effective_region to telemetry for audits.

maya: SDK UX: expose regionHint and tierOverride at SDK level; don't force customers to set raw headers. Also add guard to only send hint when different from account default to reduce noise.

sam: debug header should be admin-only. runtime should only honor X-Redwood-Routing-Debug when token has routing:debug scope. Otherwise ignore and emit telemetry event.

console-bot: deploy-check — routing integration failed on canary:

```
FAILED: variant-fallback.test.js
Expected fallback to v2 when v1 overloaded. Observed fallback to v0.
```

jordan: Investigating; looks like variant priority table was read with wrong precedence. We'll add a higher-tier priority guard so enterprise customers get quality variants first.

maya: QA asks for a Console widget: "Header Overrides" showing per-route recent overrides and counts, plus a link to raw traces.

alex: Telemetry fields to add: routing.request_region, routing.request_tier, routing.effective_variant, routing.override_source (enum: sdk, header, account), routing.effect_region. Keep them string enums.

maya: I'll draft the SDK PRs for Node/Python with examples and a short UX doc. Assigning the work.

alex: OK landing runtime tomorrow unless objections. Will open SDK PRs afterwards. :thumbsup:
